note: Best-known training settings per size. EASY MODE reads this file; HARD MODE ignores it. Every entry carries a source so no number is unattributed. Rungs marked measured_from are real runs; rungs marked pending have NOT been measured at that size yet and say so, which is why recipe_for() reports when it falls back to a neighbouring rung.

memorisation_net.meaning: gap = train_accuracy - held_out_accuracy. Training stops by itself when the gap crosses this, because a widening gap means the model is storing examples instead of learning a rule.

optimiser.name: relgrad
optimiser.meaning: scale-invariant step: w <- w - lr * g / (||g|| + eps). One setting that does not depend on model size, which is what makes a single recipe travel from small to 10B instead of needing a per-size learning-rate hunt.
optimiser.lr_semantics: how far to move in weight space, not a multiplier on an unbounded gradient

128.measured_from: lens/runs/SIZE-SWEEP.txt d=128 rung (honest accuracy and gates recorded there)
128.note: lam_act 0.0 keeps the original behaviour; the readability sweep showed a strong lam_act fixes false firing but breaks the counterfactual check, so it is off in the easy default until a value passes both

256.measured_from: sb_S0_d256_noattn_ep96, honest 9.84-10.21% on the repaired split
256.note: this is the current best model of the whole project

512.measured_from: pending: the d=512 rung of the size sweep was still training when this file was written
512.note: PENDING MEASUREMENT - the numbers here are carried from d=256 and the run will be labelled as a fallback

1024.measured_from: pending: control-token ladder rung, in the queue
1024.note: PENDING MEASUREMENT - batch halved and lr lowered as the standard scale adjustment, and that adjustment is itself a prediction to be checked, not a known result

3072.note: PENDING MEASUREMENT - d=4096 would be about 55M and is OUT of budget, so it is not in the table

default_reason: d=256 is the largest rung whose settings were actually MEASURED (honest 9.84-10.21% on the repaired split). d=512 and above are queued but not yet measured, so they are not the easy-mode default until they are.
